newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Central Greece H1 pretax down 18.4pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Central Greece H1 pretax down 18.4pct.

text.p: Bank of Central Greece said in a statement that its first-half pretax profit fell to 717.5 million drachmas from 879 million the same period a year earlier.
First-half revenues grew 12 percent to 9.5 billion drachmas, it added.

Chairman Christos Papathanassiou and managing director George Zygogiannis said the bank's 1997-1999 business plan was being implemented. The plan calls for the expansion of its retail branch network to 33 units by end-1999 from 23 currently.

The recent tender for the sale of the bank by major shareholder state Agricultural Bank of Greece was not succesfully concluded because Agricultural Bank did not find the sole bid submitted by private Egnatia Bank satisfactory.
Share of Bank of Central Greece traded 30 drachmas lower at 2,190 around mid-session on Thursday. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
